From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lara Smith <lara.smith@acmecloud.com>
Cc: procurement@orionmedia.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final two-day hygiene sprint — finance commit & stage sanitization

Team & Lara,

We're entering the final 48 hours on the ACME commit. Quick, focused asks so we can hand off clean numbers to finance tonight and push the MOP addendum for signature tomorrow morning: 

1) Stage sanitization: please update HubSpot stage to EXACTLY one of: Proposal, Legal, Procurement, Committed. No intermediates (e.g., "Verifying").
2) Commit confidence: set owner-level confidence to High/Medium/Low in the attached commit_matrix_Q4_v3.xlsx. 
3) Redlines or procurement blockers: call out specific line items and ETA to resolve. If procurement requires a PO window, note the net days.
4) Attach any current procurement docs or signed LOIs to the deal record.

Timeline: 
- Today, EOD Pacific: internal commit matrix and HubSpot stages reconciled.
- Tomorrow by 11:00 PT: David + Finance will circulate consolidated numbers to ACME and request signature.

Attachments: [Attachment: commit_matrix_Q4_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks — this needs to be surgical.

— David
David Kim
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final two-day hygiene sprint — consolidated rollup and next steps

Team / Lara,

Thanks for the rapid updates — consolidated below for Finance and ACME leadership. Please treat this as the authoritative rollup for tonight's close pack: 

Consolidated numbers (net ARR view):
- Confirmed committed (signed / PO received): $520,000 (3 deals)
- Committed pending PO / signature: $340,000 (4 deals; high confidence flagged)
- At-risk / delayed (trial slip or >12% discount pending approval): $115,000

Key actions: 
- Marissa: Legal language for data retention clause — ELT review if Legal doesn't finish by 09:00 PT Sat.
- Ben: Confirm trial start date with ACME procurement and update the deal record if > Oct 14.
- Priyom: confirm discount approval path. If any request >12%, please escalate to Finance Director before 14:00 PT tomorrow.
- David: I will submit the consolidated numbers to Finance and attach the MOP addendum. Requesting ACME signature via DocuSign; attaching the PDF to the HubSpot record.

Attachments submitted to deal: [Attachment: commit_matrix_Q4_v3.xlsx], [Attachment: signed-mop-addendum.pdf] 

External notes to ACME (Lara): if procurement can provide PO by Monday morning we'll treat the associated ARR as closed for revenue recognition planning. If there's any deviation, let us know ASAP and we will mark accordingly.

Next check-in: 08:00 PT Saturday for any overnight movement. If nothing material changes, Finance will bake these numbers into the Q4 adjacencies and we proceed with recognition timelines.

Thanks all — short and precise.

— David
David Kim
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
